notes: If the values above were read, DDC/CI is already on. Some monitors also have a toggle: Menu > System > DDC/CI.
Use a DisplayPort or HDMI cable straight to the graphics card, not a dock or adapter.
OSD-only features (Black Equalizer, Overdrive, Aim Stabilizer, FreeSync) are not standard DDC codes. Run `glint caps` and open an issue with the output to get them added.
